# AI Voice Agency

> AVA answers your phone. Every call. Books the job.

AVA is a done-for-you AI receptionist service from AI Voice Agency, based in Kewaskum, Wisconsin. AVA answers business phone lines 24/7, qualifies callers, books appointments into the business calendar, and sends text confirmations to the caller and the owner.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-17

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://aivoiceagency.ai/pricing): AVA starts at $497 a month.
- Pricing: AVA starts at $497 per month on your existing phone number, month to month. Full price in writing before you start.
- Limousine and black car companies run on AI Chauffeur (https://aichauffeur.ai), from $997 per month.
- CRM and scheduling software connections are scoped on a call. AVA connects to anything with an API.

### Included

- Every call answered
- Jobs booked on your calendar
- A confirmation text to your customer
- A text and an email to you with the job
- Every call recorded and written out
- Your own dashboard with every call
- Call details in a spreadsheet, if you want one

Play a sample call. The job ticket fills in while AVA is still on the phone. Sample calls: scripted scenarios, sample data, recorded voices. Not customer recordings.

## The questions operators ask

- What does AVA do when your phone rings? AVA answers on the first ring, day or night. It talks with the caller, gets their name, number, address and what they need, and puts the job on your calendar. The caller gets a text with the time. You get a text and an email with the job.
- Can AVA work with my existing phone number? Yes. Your customers call the same number they always have. You choose what AVA answers: every call, only after hours, or only when your team is already on the phone.
- Does AVA replace my receptionist or dispatcher? No. AVA picks up the calls your people can't get to: nights, weekends, and when two lines ring at once. Your team keeps doing the work only people can do.
- What happens when AVA can't handle a call? You pick what happens. AVA can send the call to your cell, take a message and text it to you, or set up a callback.
- AVA is an AI assistant. Demo calls are scripted samples using AVA's demo voice and sample data.
